Thank you for registering for our **Grand Opening on October 21st** . We’re delighted to confirm your participation.


You can look forward to an inspiring day of strategic updates, insightful breakout sessions, and networking opportunities with peers and industry leaders. More details on the program and logistics will be shared with you closer to the event.


We look forward to welcoming you in Frankfurt!
